subject.title: Fix Codex fork identity and cache invalidation

question: Should the repository adopt https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2120 as the canonical fork identity/cache fix and close this draft, or deliberately land this branch instead?
rationale: Both branches contain substantially the same valid implementation, but the replacement is non-draft, independently mergeable, preserves attribution, and adds an explicit cache-versioning invariant; repository policy requires a human to close the redundant draft.

options.title: Adopt the ready replacement
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2120, reconcile the overlap with https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2113, then close this draft.

options.title: Land this draft instead
options.body: Promote this branch only after adding or confirming the replacement’s cache-versioning invariant and resolving the overlapping ancestry changes.

recommendation.title: Adopt the ready replacement
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2120, reconcile the overlap with https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2113, then close this draft.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is a repository-level landing and attribution decision across overlapping contributor branches.
